title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, optimize cache and split lint/test/release
author: Jordan Lee
description:
Motivation: Our repository had grown several overlapping GitHub Actions workflows for Node-based packages (lint, unit tests, build, release). This caused maintenance overhead, duplicated caching logic, and long queue times due to large matrices. This PR consolidates the Node-related workflows into a smaller set of purpose-built workflows, standardizes actions versions, improves cache keys, and splits lint/test/release responsibilities to reduce CI runtime and improve cache hit rate.

What I changed (high level): consolidates multiple per-package workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml; extracts reusable composite actions under .github/actions/cache-setup and .github/actions/node-setup; bumps actions/checkout to v4 and uses actions/setup-node 4.x; normalizes Node matrix to supported LTS combos only (18, 20); reduces test matrix by running integration tests only on main/newer branches; centralizes caching for node_modules and yarn cache with robust keys; adds job-level concurrency and path filters to reduce unnecessary runs; moves release automation into a dedicated workflow triggered by tags and draft releases.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and remove duplicates - [x] Bump commonly used GH Actions (checkout v4, setup-node v4) - [x] Improve cache key strategy and add fallback caches - [x] Add documentation in docs/ci.md describing new conventions - [x] Run full repo CI and address flakes reported by tests

Testing: Ran full CI on branch (multiple reruns for flaky tests). Verified cache hit on subsequent runs increased from ~56% to ~82% in the sample runs. Release workflow tested by creating a draft release on my fork and confirming the automation created the release notes and assets. Rollout: feature branch deployed to main after approval; no runtime changes to production services (CI-only).

Notes: Left a short migration guide in docs/ci.md and added comments in the composite action yaml files to help future contributors. Intentionally conservative changes to avoid changing artifact signing or packaging logic. Related Linear: ENG-10234, ENG-11021.

test: narrow node matrix and add integration job filters
chore: add workflow_dispatch and repository_dispatch hooks for manual runs

Ethan Cole: Please add a quick note in docs/ci.md about how to opt a package out of the matrix. Also suggest we monitor cache hit rates for two weeks.
Jordan Lee (author): Added opt-out docs and a brief dashboard link for cache hit rate (console/ci/cache) in the notes section.
Marianne Chu: Approving pending green CI. Left a couple of nits around action versions but not blocking.
CI Bot: build (linux, node 18) passed after cache warm-up. Lint job failed on first run (eslint 8.47 rule change) — fixed in commit 3 (eslint rule pin).
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows for Node: faster builds, improved cache stability, standardized GH Actions versions, documented CI conventions. No runtime changes.
